mapper.select: SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, COMPANY_ID, ASSOCIATION_ID, GOVT_ID, BRANCH_ID, SANGSA_ID, (SELECT MAX(MEMBER_NM) FROM TM_MEMBER_DT M WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = TR_SERVICE.MEMBER_ID AND M.COMPANY_ID = TR_SERVICE.COMPANY_ID) MEMBER_NM, MEMBER_ID, CAR_NO, TO_CHAR(REQUEST_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') as REQUEST_DT, PROC_DT, TO_CHAR(JUDGE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') as JUDGE_DT, PROC_ST, JUDGE_ST, RETURN_TX, INS_USER, INS_DATE, UPD_USER, UPD_DATE, LINK_ID, IMPO_YN, READ_YN, AUTO_YN FROM TR_SERVICE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}

SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, CAR_NO, WONBU_ST, COMPANY_ID, MORT_NM, REG_GB as MORT_REG_GB, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(REG_NO) as MORT_REG_NO, BIZ_NO as MORT_BIZ_NO, BOND_AMT, PAY_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(PAY_HP_NO) AS PAY_HP_NO, PAY_ME, PAY_ST, PAY_DT, PAY_GB, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, BD_SERVICE_ID, DSIGN_GB, DSIGN_HP_GB, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(DSIGN_HP_NO) AS DSIGN_HP_NO, DSIGN_TX, DSIGN_ST, DSIGN_DT, TOTAL_AMT, IDEN_ST, IDEN_DT, CONFIRM_NO, PAY_TP, CAUSE_TX, RATIO_NO, WONBU_YN, PRE_MORT_NM, (SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM TR_JOINT WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}) GROUP_CNT FROM TR_MORTGAGE WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} FOR UPDATE

SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, EULBU_NO, CARID_NO, CAR_NM, CAR_KD, CAR_US, CAR_YY, CARREG_DT, MORT_CT, SHARE_YN, DIST_CT, INS_USER, INS_DATE, UPD_USER, UPD_DATE, PRE_CAR_NO, MORT_NM, TO_CHAR(MORTREG_DT,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS MORTREG_DT FROM TR_CARINFO WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}

SELECT ASSOCIATION_ID, COMPANY_ID, BIZ_NO, COMPANY_NO, COMPANY_NM, CEO_NM, POST_NO, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DT, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO, RT_BANK_CD, RT_ACC_NO, RT_ACC_NM, USE_YN FROM TM_COMPANY WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND ASSOCIATION_ID = #{ASSOCIATION_ID}
AND COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID}

SELECT WORK_CD, COMPANY_ID, GOVT_ID, PERM_GB, PAYMENT_GB, PAYMENT_OP, PAYMENT_TP, PAYMENT_ME, POINT_COMMON_USE, POINT_SANGSA_USE, FEE, USE_YN FROM TM_WORK_CP WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID} AND WORK_CD = #{WORK_CD} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT WORK_CD, STAMP_PER, STAMP_AMT, REGIST_PER, REGIST_AMT, STAMP_BASE, REGIST_BASE FROM TM_TAX WHERE WORK_CD = #{WORK_CD} AND sysdate between start_dt and end_dt AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT COMPANY_ID, BIZ_NO, COMPANY_NO, COMPANY_NM, '' as ADDRESS FROM TM_COMPANY WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND ASSOCIATION_ID = #{ASSOCIATION_ID} AND COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID} UNION ALL SELECT COMPANY_ID, BIZ_NO, COMPANY_NO, COMPANY_NM, ADDRESS FROM TM_COMPANY_HIS WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID}

SELECT SERVICE_ID, PAY_KD, PAY_AMT, PAY_OP, PAY_ST, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, TO_CHAR(PAY_DT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') as PAY_DT, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, REAL_PAY_ST FROM TR_PAYMENT WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} ORDER BY PAY_KD FOR UPDATE

SELECT SERVICE_ID, SEQ, GUBUN, BIZ_NO, ORG_NM, TO_CHAR(ISSUE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ISSUE_DT, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(REG_NO) AS REG_NO, CONFIRM_NO1, CONFIRM_NO2, CONFIRM_NO3, CONFIRM_NO4, DEBTOR_YN, UNION_YN, DEBTOR_NM, DEBTOR_GB, DEBTOR_RATIO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(DEBTOR_ADDR) AS DEBTOR_ADDR, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(DEBTOR_ADDR_DT) AS DEBTOR_ADDR_DT, DEBTOR_ROAD_CD, DSIGN_GB, DSIGN_HP_GB, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(DSIGN_HP_NO) AS DSIGN_HP_NO, DSIGN_TX, DSIGN_ST, TO_CHAR(DSIGN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as DSIGN_DT, IDEN_ST, TO_CHAR(IDEN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as IDEN_DT, CONFIRM_NO FROM TR_OWNERINFO WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} ORDER BY SEQ FOR UPDATE
SELECT LPAD(SEQ_SERVICE_ID.NEXTVAL, 5, 0) AS SERVICE_ID FROM DUAL
